description: This file defines the CordzInfo class used for profiling and tracking Cord objects within the Abseil library, including methods for tracking, untracking, and managing Cord references, as well as internal data structures and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: CordzInfo
classes.description: A class for profiling and tracking Cord objects, managing their lifecycle, and collecting statistics within the Abseil library.

methods.name: TrackCord
methods.description: Creates a CordzInfo instance to track metrics of a sampled Cord, and stores it in a global list.

methods.name: TrackCord (overload)
methods.description: Tracks a Cord with reference to a source Cord, used for copy construction or assignment.

methods.name: MaybeTrackCord
methods.description: Randomly samples a Cord for profiling based on profiling criteria.

methods.name: MaybeTrackCord (overload)
methods.description: Samples a Cord based on a source Cord, used for copy or assignment operations.

methods.name: Untrack
methods.description: Stops tracking a sampled Cord and cleans up associated resources.

methods.name: MaybeUntrackCord
methods.description: Safely untracks a CordzInfo if it is not null.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Retrieves the oldest existing CordzInfo in a snapshot.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Retrieves the next older CordzInfo in the list.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the CordzInfo instance for updates, increasing the update count.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the CordzInfo instance, potentially deleting it if the Cord has been cleared.

methods.name: AssertHeld
methods.description: Asserts that the instance is currently locked.

methods.name: SetCordRep
methods.description: Updates the Cord representation, requiring the lock to be held.

methods.name: RefCordRep
methods.description: Returns a reference to the current Cord representation with an added reference count.

methods.name: GetStack
methods.description: Returns the stack trace where the Cord was first sampled.

methods.name: GetParentStack
methods.description: Returns the parent stack trace for the sampled Cord.

methods.name: GetCordzStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves profiling statistics associated with the Cord.
